stories.caption:
OpenAI announced SafetyKit, scaling automated risk agents powered by its most capable models to enhance content moderation and compliance.

Traditional moderation systems rely heavily on static keyword filters and manual queues—methods that struggle with context and scale. SafetyKit introduces reasoning agents that process policy enforcement dynamically.

Swipe through for the full breakdown of how AI risk agents are reshaping digital compliance.

—
TESTED • EXPLAINED • REAL
